answer.book: Printed Latin volume of 1595 (Marburg, Egenolph) by Rodolphus Goclenius, a student disputation: a title page and dedicatory address to the patrons, then the Theses Physicae de subjecto physices with numbered theses, a short Ethicae section with its Corollaria, and a closing dedicatory poem to the respondent Valentinus Reussius.

entries.title: Consultiss. Rever. Ampliss. eruditione, & longo rerum usu praestantissimis viris
